---

## Using the format

```yaml
format: coeos-revealjs
```

## Options

This theme has no options of its own.
Everything is styled from the front matter Quarto already defines, and from RevealJS's own options.

## Front matter it reads

| Key | Used for |
| --- | --- |
| `title`, `subtitle` | The title slide. |
| `author`, `institute` | The title slide and the footer. |
| `date` | The title slide, written out in full. |
| `logo` | The corner of every slide. |
| `footer` | The centre of the footer. |

: Front matter the theme lays out. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[30,70]"}

Every RevealJS option works as usual: `slide-number`, `incremental`, `transition`, and the rest.

## The optional icon dependency

```bash
quarto add mcanouil/quarto-iconify
```

[iconify](https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-iconify) is optional.
Installing it lets the footer and slides carry icons from any Iconify set; without it, everything else works unchanged.

## Limitations

- RevealJS only.
- The theme is a look rather than a mechanism: it adds no shortcodes, filters, or classes of its own.
